definitions.explanation: Sharing a residence with someone else, whether family members, a partner, or roommates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同居|どうきょ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同居|どうきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm wondering whether to live with my parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同居|どうきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Fewer people now live with their husband's parents after marriage.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同居|どうきょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to live together)
- {同居|どうきょ}{人|にん} (cohabitant, person living together)
- {同居|どうきょ}{家族|かぞく} (family members living together)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同居|どうきょ} (living with parents)

WATCH OUT:
{同居|どうきょ} is the neutral word, most often used for family members sharing a home (especially adult children and parents or in-laws). For an unmarried couple living together, the usual word is ⟦{同棲|どうせい}→同棲：11903_dousei⟧.
